decision_es: Ventas crecen, pero rentabilidad y financiación de circulante requieren normalización antes de valorar la separación.
decision_en: Growing sales, but profitability and working-capital financing need normalization before valuing the planned separation.
pros_es: Q3 ventas 6.521,308 frente a 6.260,232, crecimiento 4,2 %: comparables 2,9 %, adquisiciones 0,9 % y divisa/otros 0,4 %.
Señales favorables: avance de Industrial, margen bruto, crecimiento comparable y capacidad de servicio.
cons_es: EBIT operativo pasa de 1.747,053 en FY23 a 1.229,216 en FY24, 960,651 en FY25 y 912,666 en el TTM septiembre de 2026.
FCF TTM de 762,849 menos financiación neta de cuentas a cobrar de 249,979 da 512,870; después de SBC de 56,759, la sensibilidad es 456,111.
Los estados actuales no reflejan la escisión.
pros_en: Q3 sales grew 4.2%, with 2.9% comparable growth, 0.9% acquisitions and 0.4% currency/other.
Industrial performance, gross margin and the distribution network offer operating strengths.
cons_en: Operating EBIT fell from $1,747.053m in FY23 to $912.666m in the September 2026 TTM despite revenue growth.
TTM FCF of $762.849m falls to $512.870m after net receivables-sale financing, or $456.111m after a further SBC sensitivity; neither is certified owner FCF.
The proposed Automotive/Motion separation is not reflected in current financial statements; capital allocation and stand-alone costs remain unresolved.
publication_note: Preserve A040/A052 and original Oct 19 scanner 130.18, QP 80, Opportunity 100, RSI 50.5 and historic Stage 2 Yes. No current entry, completed Stage 3 or certified owner FCF. Next exact earnings date unconfirmed; Q1 2027 separation remains conditional.
